role: variables operations relations and arity function
notes: Pairwise disjoint symbol sets; V infinite; operation and relation arities are finite.

role: false and true formula constants
notes: Source truth constants; 0 is allowed in the positive fragment and empty disjunction; 1 is empty conjunction.

role: distinguished auxiliary binary relation later genuine identity
notes: Before quotienting this is a freely interpreted relation symbol; relational systems interpret it as identity.

role: selected relation symbols and their disjoint primed copies
notes: Same respective arities; Q-positive permits negative atoms outside Q.

role: simultaneous relation-symbol replacement in a formula
notes: Replace precisely symbols in Q by corresponding Q-prime symbols; do not prime the diagram constants or e_A.

role: relation inclusion theory
notes: One universally closed inclusion per selected relation symbol.

role: local structures with domain understood from context
notes: Domain notation and indexed interpretations are declared together; these letters do not denote axioms.

role: onto Q-map or onto homomorphism
notes: Preserves total operations and relations; reflects relations outside Q.

role: model class and common sentence theory
notes: The input type determines the dual role; double star is logical or elementary closure respectively.

role: map kernel or specified congruence
notes: For a map h kernel means h(a)=h(a-prime); all auxiliary relation congruence conditions are needed for a zero-map quotient.

role: expanded language named expansion fresh identity relation and constants
notes: e_A is a new ordinary relation; its congruence quotient extracts the elementary extension; w_a is the source named constant.

role: identity quotients and induced map
notes: Quotient by the congruence interpreting e; genuine-identity projection is a {e}-map rather than an auxiliary empty-set-map.

role: class of onto homomorphic images of a stated class
notes: Distinct from H the ambient relative elementary class.

role: ambient elementary class in relative preservation
notes: Both endpoints of the relative maps must belong to H; H need not be image-closed.

role: source rooted infinite-extension condition and finite chain conditions
notes: Initial edge is conjoined outside the implication in S; witnesses of S_n need not be distinct.

role: Skolem constants unary operation and iterated chain terms
notes: t_0=s_0 and t_1=s_1; t_(i+1)=s(t_i) only for i at least one.

role: Skolem variable substitution and variable-disjoint copy renamings
notes: Skolem witness operations depend only on preceding universals; duplication prefix respects each original dependency.

role: block universal variables existential witnesses fresh universals and Skolem operations
notes: Specialization terms for x_(pq) may use only y_s with s less than p; prefix dependency requirements are explicit.

role: Boolean substitution on atomic formulas in source chain argument
notes: Keeps rooted-chain atoms and sends every other atom to 0; not a variable substitution.

role: set of substitution instances of the Skolem matrix
notes: Formulas not sentences; source Boolean substitution and finite propositional compactness apply to this set.

role: sentences true in all one-element models of T
notes: Recursive membership uses the finite axiomatization; distinct local use from source Skolem instance set in the chain annex.
